name: Nava Ltd
title: Nava Ltd - 513023 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Standalone PAT up 116% to INR 911 crore on overseas dividends and buyback proceeds, not operations; ferro-alloy prices under pressure while power PLF guided higher on cheaper Singareni coal.

utilisation.quote: we are able to operate year-round with a higher PLF and gain more contracts

capex.peers_comment: India now produces about 4 million tons of manganese alloys, out of which approximately 1 million is slated for export

triggers.label: Ferro-alloy pricing pressure from surplus supply
triggers.quote: we are seeing a lot of that material being dumped in the domestic market, which is essentially causing the prices to come down

triggers.label: Power PLF to improve year-round
triggers.quote: we're going to be looking at a fairly better overall PLF

triggers.label: Dumping and EU safeguard duties on Indian alloys
triggers.quote: the European Union has imposed safeguard duties against Indian imports into the country

triggers.label: Ferro-silicon discontinued
triggers.quote: We've actually discontinued ferro silicon, because the market for silico manganese is more favorable at the moment.

guidance.quote: I think in total we're looking at about 130,000 tons for the next year.
we can expect somewhere close to INR 5.50
at least commissioning is supposed to commence in the month of July, 2026
is to be commissioned during the early part of January 2027

red_flags.label: Profit inflated by one-off FX/ECL reversal and dividends
red_flags.quote: The growth was primarily supported by healthy upstream dividend flows from our overseas investments and buyback proceeds received during the year.

red_flags.label: Consolidated margin down QoQ; other income drop
red_flags.quote: There are decreases in the other income by INR 18 crore in Q4.

red_flags.label: Deferred tax hit from Kwacha appreciation
red_flags.quote: the increase in deferred tax expenses, which is a non -cash item, was primarily driven by approximately 32% appreciation of the Zambian Kwacha

red_flags.label: Management declined to size Nacharam land value
